question: Should `2026.7.1-2` be promoted as the default gateway LKG after the upstream startup report is dispositioned and the requested Windows/WSL acceptance matrix passes?
rationale: “Last known good” is a release-quality designation rather than a code-style choice; the required risk disposition and supported-environment acceptance evidence need release-owner judgment.

options.title: Validate then promote
options.body: Obtain the requested current-head acceptance evidence and upstream-report disposition, then merge the centralized pin if the candidate passes.

options.title: Retain the current LKG
options.body: Keep `2026.6.11` as the default until the candidate has a documented supported-environment validation result.
